subject.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose and auto-enable `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache` for DeepSeek, or require a different provider-owned/cache-capability contract before merging this fix?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it adds public compatibility surface and intentionally changes DeepSeek instruction placement for existing users; repository policy requires provider-owner intent rather than inferring that permanent contract from successful tests alone.

options.title: Approve DeepSeek-only compat policy
options.body: Rebase and merge the live-proven DeepSeek default with explicit `false` opt-out while leaving Xiaomi and other endpoints opt-in.

options.title: Replace the public knob
options.body: Keep the trailing-carrier behavior but express it through a positive provider cache capability or internal provider policy before merge.

options.title: Pause for the config-free alternative
options.body: Do not land this branch unless the competing general solution gains equivalent live DeepSeek proof and demonstrates safe behavior for other OpenAI-compatible providers.

recommendation.title: Approve DeepSeek-only compat policy
recommendation.body: Rebase and merge the live-proven DeepSeek default with explicit `false` opt-out while leaving Xiaomi and other endpoints opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history is the strongest available connection to the boundary-aware prompt-cache design and the affected OpenAI-compatible transport behavior.
